title: The first sip
premise: A sleepy morning: the kettle, the grinder, the bloom, and the first sip that finally switches the day on. The twist: the cup was for the cat-shaped mug on the windowsill all along.
reference: none: first piece in the series

title: Oat or whole?
premise: Five this-or-that pairs for a home flat white: oat or whole, mug or glass, one shot or two, sugar or none, morning or afternoon. Ask viewers to comment their five letters.

title: How many coffee habits do you have?
premise: A checklist of seven small home-coffee habits (weighing beans, a favourite mug, reheating the same cup twice...). The viewer counts theirs and comments the number.
